title: Board Sizes: cross-referenced
lede: The Board Info sheet, the 2024 Camp Randall content guide, Colosseum’s 196_WISC deliverables sheet and the Wisconsin Board Builder, merged display by display. Every position and note says which source it came from; where they disagree, the page says so.

changes.h: The sheet had sizes; the guide had the rules
changes.was: Frame rates, stills-only windows, 30 s exact durations, 20 px border pad, speaker-scrim blanks and safe areas lived only in a 42-page PDF.
changes.now: Each display shows its delivery spec; each window shows its tags and guide page; the drawings show crops, scrims and seams.

changes.was: Only the Club Board had offsets.
changes.now: North Board, Kellner and Section A from the Board Builder’s geometry; fascias and south end zone where the sizes force the layout (and the sheet’s older tab agrees). Stated vs derived positions are drawn differently.

changes.was: No HD feed, IPTV, LaBahn or Goodman; the sheet’s LaBahn and Goodman tabs are empty.
changes.now: All added with their sources: guide and Board Builder for the feed and IPTV, Colosseum plus the production AEP for LaBahn, Colosseum only for Goodman (flagged).

changes.was: Colosseum lists the Kohl Center fascia at 72 px and builds at 60 fps; the sheet says 144 px; the AE project renders at 59.94.
changes.now: Red notes for anything to confirm; neutral notes for provenance and explanations.

notes: The 2022 guide describes the retired system (6000 × 72 fascia, 306 × 414 wings, TriLogo main) and matches the sheet’s hidden OLD CR tab; it’s used only to confirm history, not as a source.
Colosseum’s social sizes (1080 × 1920, 1080 × 1350) are deliverables, not boards, and are left out.
Contact names and phone numbers in the guides are not published on this public page.
Kohl Center zone positions exist only in the sheet’s OLD tab; not used, since that tab is superseded.
